verdict.rationale: Ramp's own materials describe a finance team issuing instant virtual cards for each software subscription with per-vendor spending limits (ramp-docs-31). Ramp also documents merchant- and amount-scoped card credentials, pointing to Virtual Cards for reusable vendor cases (ramp-supp-agent-cards), and per-merchant spend restrictions with auto-expiring cards (ramp-supp-agents-site). A community user independently confirms spinning up a new expense card in under a minute (ramp-comm-2). Missing for 10: explicit evidence of purpose or category scoping such as ad spend (beyond single-vendor locks), and in-depth first-party documentation of card-control settings beyond marketing-level claims.
